rows.query: How many units of Butter batch 4609 were recalled and why?
rows.answer: Butter batch 4609 was recalled due to bacterial contamination. The recall was initiated by Valley Fresh as part of an internal audit. The affected units are 3671, and the recall code is RCL-2026-04609. The contamination came from lot #L14609, and the product should not be eaten. Consumers are advised to stop using the product, throw it away, or return it to the store. Clean surfaces it touched and seek medical attention if symptoms develop.
